correctness.rationale: In the flat glide-reflection quotient (x,y)~(x+L,-y), the only competitive minimizing straight lifts are even displacement d and odd displacement L-d, with squared lengths d²+(y1-y2)² and (L-d)²+(y1+y2)²; other parity lifts have longer horizontal displacement. For normalized absolute heights u,v and r=W/L, sign-opposite even and sign-equal odd geodesics cross the core only when 0<ell<(L/2)(1-r²uv). Because d has triangular density 2(L-d)/L², adding the two fair sign cases yields a *constant* ell-density 1/L, hence joint unnormalized marks density (1/2)1_{0<u,v,z<1,z+r²uv<1}. Integrating over U*V gives product CDF G(t)=t(1-log t) and antiderivative H(t), so P(Z>z|E)=H((1-z)/r²)/H(1/r²). The elasticity tGprime/G decreases, giving monotone likelihood ratio with strict inequality on a nonempty interval for any r2>r1, hence strict stochastic order; thin r->0 gives Uniform and thick r->infty gives Beta(1,2). Horizontal translation action makes intersection location Haar-uniform independent marks. Independently simulated endpoint pairs with rederived parity geodesics at r=.3,1,2.2 (120000 per r) and checked crossing probabilities/survival, plus checked algebraic limits; simulations are corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: For a canonical nonorientable flat surface, the full distribution of path geometry given a random geodesic crosses the core is naturally informative beyond an event frequency. An exact uniform three-dimensional region, independent uniform intersection arclength, strict monotone likelihood-ratio order of spans across every aspect ratio, and Uniform/Beta endpoint laws are motivated, usable mathematical probability facts, not a mere re-expression of the known marginal.

limitations: Only intrinsic rectangular flat Möbius band, two area-uniform endpoints, and shortest-geodesic horizontal displacement, not full arclength/angle distribution or curved surfaces.
The scalar crossing probability is known and not claimed as novel.
Best-of-knowledge originality; no claim of exhaustive priority or formal/expert certification.
